questions.questionText: Which sentence places the adverb correctly?

options.a: She quickly ran to the door.
options.b: She ran quickly to the door.
options.c: Quickly she ran to the door.
options.d: She ran to the door quickly.

questions.explanation: Adverb position: manner adverb before main verb (quickly ran).

questions.questionText: Which sentence has correct adjective order?
Which sentence uses 'as...as' correctly?

options.a: She is as tall as her mother.
options.b: She is as tall her mother.
options.c: She is so tall as her mother.
options.d: She is tall as her mother.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'than' correctly?

options.a: He is taller than his brother.
options.c: He is more tall than his brother.
options.d: He is more taller than his brother.

questions.questionText: Form the comparative of 'happy'.
questions.explanation: Short adjectives ending in -y: change y to i + er (happier).

questions.questionText: Form the superlative of 'fast'.
Form the adverb of manner from 'quick'.
Where should 'always' be placed in 'She is late'?
questions.explanation: Frequency adverb 'always' goes before main verb.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'every' correctly?

options.a: Every student must bring a pen.
options.b: Every students must bring a pen.
options.d: Every a student must bring a pen.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'another' correctly?
Which sentence uses 'both' correctly?

options.d: Both of my brothers are tall.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'neither' correctly?
Which sentence uses zero article correctly?
questions.explanation: Zero article + plural noun for general statement.

questions.questionText: Identify the subject pronoun.
Choose the possessive adjective.
Choose the reflexive pronoun.
Identify the relative pronoun.

options.a: The girl whose bag is red is my sister.
options.b: The girl who bag is red is my sister.
options.c: The girl which bag is red is my sister.
options.d: The girl where bag is red is my sister.

questions.questionText: Identify the relative adverb in the sentence 'The summer when I was ten was very hot.'
Identify the relative adverb in the sentence 'The cafe where we met is closed.'
Add the correct question tag: 'You are happy, ___?'
Add the correct question tag: 'You aren't tired, ___?'
Which sentence uses coordinating conjunction correctly?

options.c: I like tea or coffee or.
options.d: I like tea and but coffee.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'because' correctly?

options.a: I stayed home because it rained.
options.b: I stayed home so it rained.
options.d: Because I stayed home, it rained.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses 'while' correctly?
Which sentence uses 'although' correctly?

options.c: Although she is tired, she keeps working.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct preposition: 'I wake up ___ 7 o'clock.'
Choose the correct preposition: 'I was born ___ March.'
Choose the correct preposition: 'My birthday is ___ 15th June.'
Choose the correct preposition: 'She walked ___ the room.'
Choose the correct preposition: 'The train went ___ the tunnel.'
questions.explanation: 'Through' = movement from one side to another (in enclosed space).

questions.questionText: Choose the synonym of 'big'.
Choose the antonym of 'tall'.
What does the idiom 'out of sorts' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Out of sorts' = feeling slightly unwell or off.

questions.questionText: What does 'blood is thicker than water' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Blood is thicker than water' = family ties are strongest.

questions.questionText: What does the idiom 'burn the midnight oil' mean?

options.a: Work or study late into the night

questions.explanation: 'Burn the midnight oil' = work or study late at night.

questions.questionText: What does 'look after' mean in 'Can you look after my dog this weekend?'
What does 'take off' (clothing) mean?
What does 'put on' mean?
What does 'turn on' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Turn on' = start a device (light, TV, etc.).

questions.questionText: What does 'turn off' mean?
Which word is formed with the suffix '-er' (agent)?
Which word is formed with the suffix '-tion'?
Choose the word using the prefix 're-' (again).
Choose the word using the prefix 'un-' (not).
Identify the compound noun.
Read: 'Hey! How's it going? Wanna hang out this weekend? Miss you!' What is this?
questions.explanation: Format: casual greeting, contractions, friendly tone.

questions.questionText: Read: 'Dentist appt. Tuesday 3pm. Don't forget!' What is this?
questions.explanation: Format: abbreviations + brief reminder = short note.

questions.questionText: Read: 'Dear Auntie Mei, Thanks for the birthday present! Love, Sara.' What is this?
Read a menu with sections: Appetizers, Main Courses, Desserts, Beverages. What is this?
Read: 'Step 1: Boil water. Step 2: Add pasta. Step 3: Cook 10 minutes.' What is this?
Read: 'N = North. Turn left at the roundabout. Hospital is 200m ahead.' What is this?
Read: 'Monday: Sunny, 30°C. Tuesday: Rainy, 22°C. Wednesday: Cloudy, 25°C.' What is this?
Read: 'MEGA SALE! 70% OFF everything. Today only!' What is this?
Read: 'This phone has 6GB RAM, 128GB storage, and a 48MP camera. Battery: 5000mAh.' What is this?
Read: 'Once upon a time, a girl lived in a small house. One day, she found a magic key.' What is this?
questions.explanation: Narrative + 'Once upon a time' = story opening.

questions.questionText: Read: '"Hello, Tom!" said Anna. "How are you?" Tom replied.' What is this?
Read: 'Step 1: Attach leg A to panel B. Step 2: Secure with screws.' What is this?
Read: 'Favourite subjects: Maths 35%, Science 25%, English 20%, Others 20%.' What is this?
Read: 'SCHOOL CARNIVAL! Saturday, 10am-4pm. Food! Games! Prizes!' What is this?
questions.explanation: Format: event name + date + activities = poster.

questions.questionText: Combine: 'He is tall. He is strong.'
Combine: 'She sings. She dances.'
Combine: 'Study hard. Fail.' (use 'or')
Combine: 'He didn't call. He didn't text.'

options.a: He didn't call, nor did he text.
options.b: He didn't call and he didn't text.
options.c: He didn't call but he texted.
options.d: He didn't call so he texted.

questions.questionText: Combine: 'She is poor. She is generous.' (use 'yet')

options.a: She is poor, yet she is generous.

questions.subtopic: Sentence combining two clauses with so
questions.questionText: Combine: 'She was tired. She went to sleep early.' (use 'so')

options.a: She was tired, so she went to sleep early.
options.b: She was tired and she went to sleep early.
options.c: She was tired but she went to sleep early.
options.d: She was tired or she went to sleep early.

questions.subtopic: Sentence error subject verb agreement basic
questions.questionText: Find the error: 'The dogs runs in the park.'
Find the error: 'She is honest woman.'
Find the error: 'I am good in Mathematics.'
Find the error: 'She is a beauty girl.'
Find the error: 'She goes always to school.'
questions.explanation: Word order: adverb 'always' before main verb.

questions.questionText: Transform to negative: 'She is happy.'
Transform to question: 'He is a doctor.'
Transform to passive: 'She writes a letter.'

options.a: A letter is written by her.
options.b: A letter is wrote by her.
options.d: A letter being written by her.

questions.explanation: Passive: object + is/am/are + past participle + by agent.

questions.questionText: Convert to indirect: 'I am tired,' she said.

options.a: She said that she was tired.
options.b: She said that she is tired.
options.d: She told that she was tired.

questions.questionText: Choose the informal email greeting for a friend.
Choose the informal email closing for a friend.
Choose the email to make an appointment.

options.a: Could we schedule a meeting for next Tuesday at 2pm?

questions.explanation: Appointment request: 'Could we schedule a meeting...'

questions.questionText: Choose the email confirming an appointment.

options.a: Thank you. I confirm our meeting on Tuesday at 2pm.

questions.questionText: Choose the meeting notice.

options.a: NOTICE: Staff meeting, Friday 10am, Conference Room B.

questions.questionText: Choose the event cancellation notice.

options.a: NOTICE: The concert on Saturday is cancelled due to weather.

questions.questionText: Choose the polite phone answer.

options.a: Good morning, ABC Company, Sarah speaking. How may I help you?

questions.questionText: Choose the message asking for a return call.

options.a: Could you please call me back at your earliest convenience?

questions.questionText: Choose the polite acceptance.

options.a: Thank you for the invitation. I would love to attend.

questions.questionText: Choose the email apology for lateness.

options.a: I apologize for my late response. I will send the report today.

questions.questionText: How would you ask someone for the time?

options.a: Excuse me, could you tell me the time, please?

questions.explanation: Polite time request: 'Excuse me + could you tell me...'

questions.questionText: How would you ask the price of an item?

options.a: Excuse me, how much does this cost?

questions.explanation: Polite price question: 'how much does this cost?'

questions.questionText: How would you order food at a restaurant?

options.a: I'd like to order the chicken rice, please.

questions.questionText: How would you make a complaint politely?

options.a: I'm sorry to bother you, but I'm afraid there's a small problem.

questions.questionText: How would you return an item to a shop?

options.a: I'd like to return this item, please. I have the receipt.

questions.questionText: How would you ask for help in class?

options.a: Excuse me, could you help me with this question, please?

questions.explanation: Polite help request: 'Excuse me + could you help...'

questions.questionText: How would you introduce your friend to someone?

options.a: This is my friend, John. John, this is Sarah.

questions.explanation: Introduction: 'This is my friend + name + This is + name.'

questions.questionText: How would you describe someone tall with brown hair?

options.a: She is tall and has long brown hair.

questions.questionText: How would you describe your hobby?

options.a: I enjoy reading novels in my free time.

questions.explanation: Hobby: 'I enjoy + activity + in my free time.'

questions.questionText: How would you ask about someone's weekend plans?

options.a: What are you planning to do this weekend?

questions.explanation: Weekend question: 'What are you planning to do this weekend?'

questions.questionText: Read: 'The cat is fat / The dog sat on the mat.' Which words rhyme?
questions.explanation: End rhyme: 'fat' / 'mat' (rhyming sound at line end).

questions.questionText: What is the rhythm pattern in 'I went to the store' (in syllables)?
Read: 'Aisha always helps her friends and listens carefully.' What trait does Aisha show?
Read: 'In a small village in 1950, Tom lived with his family.' What is the setting?
Read: 'The tortoise kept going slowly and won the race. The hare rested and lost.' What is the moral?

options.a: Slow and steady wins the race.

questions.explanation: Moral: persistence and steady effort win.
